# What A Portrait

> Custom hand-painted portrait service converting photos to original artwork in multiple mediums and styles.

What A Portrait specializes in converting personal photographs into hand-painted portraits using traditional art techniques including oil, watercolor, pastel, charcoal, colored pencil, and graphite pencil. The service offers both realistic and impressionistic styles, catering to individual portraits, family commissions, pet paintings, and special occasion gifts.

## Key Topics

- Custom hand-painted portraits
- Oil painting (fine brush & thick brush)
- Charcoal portraits (smooth & sketchy)
- Pencil portraits (smooth & sketchy)
- Colored pencil artwork
- Watercolor painting
- Pastel portraits
- Photo-to-art conversion
- Wedding portraits
- Pet portraits
- Gift portraits
- Realistic style
- Impressionist style
- Custom art commissions
- Fine detail artistry
